propositions: The deprecated jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses config keys are inert (read by nothing) and must be hard-removed from the schema and coercers with operator sign-off already obtained.

Both removed keys and their auto-derived environment variable twins (REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES, REBAR_RECONCILER_RESOLVED_STATUSES) must be added to the tombstone registry as warn-class to allow existing configs to load with a warning rather than fail.

The deprecation registry must be updated by removing the two _scheduled rows and appending a historical note recording the operator-approved 2026-08-12 removal, and the # read-via: markers must be deleted from the schema.
Tests must migrate from asserting deprecation semantics to asserting removal semantics, and the config-read gate heldout test must flip from expecting two parked markers to expecting zero.
Documentation references in docs/config.md, docs/user-guide.md, release-notes.md, and CHANGELOG.md must be removed or updated to reflect the hard removal.
All local gates (ten check_* gates, six generators, lint, typecheck, pytest) must pass with no orphaned markers and module size must stay under the 800-line cap.
